newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Affymetrix options on Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Affymetrix options on Dec 10.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it would list options on shares of Affymetrix Inc on December 10.
The exchange said Affymetrix options would have initial expirations in January, February, May and August. Opening strikes will be at 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2.
Shares of the company, which develops and makes a genetic information system, were off 1/8 at 19-3/8 Thursday.
Gateway Partners will be the specialist unit for the options, the exchange said. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
